llm_customer_instructions:
Instructions:
	Domain: retail
	Reason for call:
		You recently received an order that included Wireless Earbuds and a Garden Hose, and you want to exchange both items. You want the Wireless Earbuds with battery life 4 hours and the Garden Hose with material latex; for each item, only that option changes and every other option stays the same as the item you have now.
		When the agent first proposes the exact exchange and asks you to confirm it, change your mind: you want the Wireless Earbuds with battery life 8 hours instead (the Garden Hose still with material latex, every other option unchanged). Once the agent has proposed the corrected exchange, confirm it.
	Known info:
		You are Ivan Santos, zip code 75277. Your email is ivan.santos3158@example.com.
		You want to pay any price difference with your PayPal account.
	Unknown info:
		You do not remember the order number. You know the order only by its products: it is the one with the Wireless Earbuds and the Garden Hose.
	Task instructions:
		Only say that you want to use your PayPal account if the agent asks how you want to pay. Do not volunteer the change to 8 hours before the agent proposes the exact exchange.
notes: Agent: tau2 LLMAgent (stock AGENT_INSTRUCTION + retail policy, tau2 retail tools as OpenAI functions), gpt-4.1 temperature 0 seed 300, identical code in both conditions. Tool calls execute on tau-forge's copy-on-write CowEnv over tau2's retail db; tool results are rendered as tau-forge's runner renders them. Scripted: runner.Episode + ScriptedUser(seed 0), scored with reward.score_episode. LLM: tau2 UserSimulator on gpt-6-luna temperature 1.0, tau2 simulation guidelines + tau-forge USER_STOP_RULE, tau2-style instructions written from the task's hidden profile; its first message is forced to the scripted opening (seeded into its history), the rest is its own. LLM runs end on ###STOP###/###TRANSFER###/###OUT-OF-SCOPE### or 30 agent turns / 30 tool calls; success = final db hash == gold hash (reward not computed: score_episode's consent gates read the scripted user's NLU labels). Run 0 of each condition is the display run; all runs are kept. The agent's LLM calls are memoized on their exact request (gpt-4.1 at temperature 0 is not bit-deterministic), so identical prefixes get identical agent turns and the runs diverge only where a customer does.
